description: Evaluation set for the local AI-governance corpus. Expected sources and findings were grounded by hand against the committed passages (see notebook 'Evaluation'). Offline questions are answerable from the local corpus alone; they are the default eval to keep results reproducible without live web search.

questions.question: What transparency and documentation obligations does the EU AI Act place on providers of general-purpose AI models?

expected_findings.label: Keep technical documentation of the model
Put in place a copyright policy
Publish a summary of training content

questions.question: How does the EU AI Act's risk-based approach compare with the risk management approach in the NIST AI Risk Management Framework?

expected_findings.label: EU Act tiers AI by risk (prohibited / high-risk)
NIST organises work into govern, map, measure, manage
EU Act imposes binding legal obligations

questions.question: What risks are specific to generative AI according to NIST, and which part of the EU AI Act is most relevant to governing such models?

expected_findings.label: EU AI Act GPAI / general-purpose model provisions are relevant
